text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 剧场门厅.
Environment: Theatre foyer with entrance glazing, reception or ticket area, seating and connected doors to auditorium.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 2 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create two stacked wide views of this foyer from opposite ends. A faces NORTH: reception desk northwest at left; theater entrance centered north; brochure rack northeast at right. B faces SOUTH: glazed main entrance centered with windows and benches beside it; reception desk visible in right foreground, brochure rack left foreground. Preserve positions, no copied or moved furnishing. Labels A B only.
